# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest version of AI Lan is supported for security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.3.0   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.3.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities directly to the maintainers. Do not open an issue on the public repository.

We aim to respond to security reports within 48 hours and provide a fix or mitigation as soon as possible.
